title: Chainring
tagline: Tap the instant a ball hits a ring

fr.tagline: Tape à l’instant où l’anneau se referme sur la balle. Chaque anneau tombe sur un temps de la musique.

en.tagline: Tap the instant the closing ring hits the ball. Every ring lands on a beat of the track.

description: Tap the instant a closing ring hits the bouncing ball — every ring lands on a beat of the track, but some beats are empty. Chain perfect taps for a huge combo, then survive the spiked sudden-death ring.
